title: 2026 ONS greenhouse-gas basis bridge QA controls

facts.source_fact: ONS reports UK greenhouse-gas emissions on territorial, residence/production and footprint/consumption bases.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve the named emissions basis on every value.

facts.source_fact: Territorial emissions cover emissions occurring within UK geographical borders and support UK-wide target tracking.
facts.expected_handling: Do not label territorial values as residence or footprint values.

facts.source_fact: Residence emissions cover UK residents and UK-registered businesses whether emissions occur in the UK or overseas.
Footprint emissions cover supply-chain emissions of goods and services consumed in the UK wherever production occurs.
facts.expected_handling: Keep consumption and embedded-import boundary explicit.

facts.source_fact: Territorial estimates currently exclude international aviation and shipping.
facts.expected_handling: Do not silently add international transport to territorial totals.

facts.source_fact: Residence estimates include aviation and shipping from British operators or carriers and UK tourists abroad.
facts.expected_handling: Carry operator/residence attribution when reconciling transport.

facts.source_fact: Footprint estimates include emissions embedded in imports and exclude emissions from UK-produced goods that are exported.
For 2023 ONS cites 384 MtCO2e territorial, 480 MtCO2e residence and 699 MtCO2e footprint emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Use the same reference year when comparing bases.

facts.source_fact: Previous-year estimates may be revised because underlying data or methods improve.
facts.expected_handling: Version values by release and do not treat revisions as errors by default.

facts.source_fact: The 2026 atmospheric bridge dataset links UK Environmental Accounts measures with UNFCCC and UNECE measures for 1990 to 2024.
facts.expected_handling: Use the bridge for boundary reconciliation rather than parcel inference.

guard_patterns.handling: Require territorial, residence or footprint label.
Require identical year before numeric comparison.
Keep MtCO2e and CO2e semantics explicit.
Do not infer site or parcel emissions from national bridge data.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; 10 x 10 = 100 controls
